subject.title: chore(telegram): add MCP App Funnel proof fixture

question: Should the protected Telegram proof workflow be allowed to execute the version-pinned remote MCP App runtime through a Funnel-backed fixture, or must the fixture serve an approved local artifact instead?
rationale: This is a deliberate trust-boundary choice for credentialed QA infrastructure; source-level review alone cannot choose the acceptable external-code and public-origin policy.

options.title: Serve an approved local fixture artifact
options.body: Package or snapshot the required MCP App runtime inside the trusted proof environment so the credentialed Funnel scenario does not fetch executable browser code from a CDN.

options.title: Approve the pinned CDN boundary
options.body: Retain the exact-version jsDelivr import only if the responsible owner accepts its provenance, availability, and incident-response tradeoff for this protected workflow.

recommendation.title: Serve an approved local fixture artifact
recommendation.body: Package or snapshot the required MCP App runtime inside the trusted proof environment so the credentialed Funnel scenario does not fetch executable browser code from a CDN.

likelyOwner.reason: They own both this proof prerequisite and the linked MCP App channel-view proposal, so they are the best available first routing point for the intended proof design.
